source_repository.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR)
source_repository.usage_note: Historical and spaceflight research datasets only. Never present OSDR records as live astronaut vital signs.

datasets.title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panel and Immune/Cardiac Cytokine Arrays (Comprehensive Metabolic Panel and Multiplex)
datasets.license_or_terms: CC0-1.0 (open metadata/transformed tables); controlled raw human files subject to OSDR Data Access Request (DAR) / IRB Protocol 21-05023569
datasets.mission_or_platform: SpaceX Inspiration4 (3-day LEO mission, 2021-09-16 to 2021-09-18, 4 civilian astronauts)
assay_types: Analytical Chemistry - Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (Quest Diagnostics, Beckman Coulter AU5800)
Immunoassay Multiplex - Eve Technologies Human Cytokine/Chemokine 71-Plex (HD71)
Immunoassay Multiplex - Eve Technologies Human Cardiovascular Disease Panel 3 9-Plex (HDCVD9)
Immunoassay Multiplex - Alamar Biosciences NULISAseq Inflammation Panel
measurement_units: NPQ (NULISA Protein Quantification, log2 IPC-normalized counts)
pg/mL (extrapolated cytokine concentration, normalized to pre-flight mean)
Standard clinical chemistry CMP units (Quest Diagnostics test code 10231)
day (mission-relative timepoints L-92, L-44, L-3, R+1, R+45, R+82, R+194)
datasets.limitations: Short-duration (3-day) LEO mission with n=4 subjects; pre-flight and post-flight ground draws only (no in-flight serum draws); not live telemetry or diagnostic thresholds.

datasets.title: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission (RNA-seq, epitranscriptome, WGS, clonal hematopoiesis, CBC)
datasets.license_or_terms: CC0-1.0 (open metadata/processed summaries); controlled human genomic files subject to OSDR DAR / IRB
datasets.mission_or_platform: SpaceX Inspiration4 (3-day LEO mission, 2021-09, 4 civilian astronauts)
assay_types: Complete Blood Count (Quest Diagnostics Hematology Analyzer)
Whole Genome Sequencing & Clonal Hematopoiesis 9-gene panel (Element Biosciences / Illumina)
Long-read Direct RNA Sequencing (Oxford Nanopore Technologies PromethION)
measurement_units: Standard CBC hematology counts and concentrations
datasets.limitations: n=4 crew members; ground timepoints only; raw genomic sequencing files are controlled access.

datasets.title: Cell-free RNA analysis of plasma samples collected from six astronauts in JAXA Cell-Free Epigenome (CFE) Study
datasets.publisher: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) / JAXA
datasets.license_or_terms: NASA OSDR open science terms (de-identified processed RNA-seq tables; ethics approvals Tsukuba No. 251, JAXA JX-IRBA-20-071, NASA Pro1995, ESA 2017_04_09)
datasets.mission_or_platform: International Space Station (ISS) long-duration >120 days (6 astronauts)
assay_types: Transcription Profiling - Plasma Cell-Free RNA Sequencing (Illumina NextSeq 500, 2x36 bp paired-end)
Transcription Profiling - CD36-enriched Extracellular Mitochondria (exMT) RNA-Seq (Illumina NextSeq 500)
measurement_units: degree Celsius (UO:0000027, -95 C ISS / -80 C ground)
log2 normalized gene expression counts and fold-change / SEM
datasets.limitations: Small cohort (n=6 astronauts); group-level mean/SEM summaries in public .xlsx tables; longitudinal research archive, not real-time vital signs.

datasets.title: Effects of Spaceflight on Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Derived Cardiomyocyte Structure and Function
datasets.mission_or_platform: ISS SpaceX CRS-9, Space Automated Bioproduct Laboratory (SABL), 5.5 weeks microgravity
assay_types: Transcription Profiling - RNA Sequencing (Illumina HiSeq 2000, 100 bp paired-end)
Cellular calcium-handling and cardiomyocyte structure/function comparison
measurement_units: degree Celsius (37 C culture; 4 C RNALater storage)
datasets.limitations: In vitro hiPSC-derived cardiomyocyte model (3 donor lines, 18 samples), not whole-organ human clinical telemetry.

datasets.title: Hippocampal DNA Methylation (5mC/5hmC) and Transcriptomic Response Following Whole-Body Proton Irradiation
datasets.mission_or_platform: Ground-based space radiation analog (whole-body proton irradiation, 2-week and 20-week timepoints)
assay_types: Epigenetic Profiling - DIP-Seq (5mC and 5hmC DNA methylation, Illumina HiSeq 2000, 75 bp single-end)
Transcription Profiling - RNA Sequencing (Illumina HiSeq, processed with GeneLab GL-DPPD-7101-G / DESeq2)
datasets.limitations: Animal (Mus musculus) ground-based proton analog; informs radiation neurobiology mechanisms rather than direct human clinical thresholds.
